ImageDescription.value: Here, Flaming Katy, growing in water (after designed), made several my small koi (Wikipedia introduction: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Koi ) and a couple of golden frogs (it's very hard to find their specific type, which we can refer to its frog article and try to find: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frog ) feel very happy in their universe. Sorry, my little ones, I didn't have too much money and time to make you happy, but I can bring many small items bought during the trips to UK and many other places of China, into the fish tank. Meanwhile, we - teachers and learners - have piano music to let you dance... Especially the two frogs , I found: when they heard some plays of beautiful piano-music from students, they really wanted to swimming-dance, as if they were also performers in their small world.

Artist.value: Jason M. C., Han

77460091.title: File:Small items in Commons Life of 2019 Spring 4.jpg

ObjectName.value: Small items in Commons Life of 2019 Spring 4

Categories.value: Houseplants|Potted plants|Self-published work|Unidentified Kalanchoe|Piano education in music laboratory|Ambiguous equipment in Exif

ImageDescription.value:
Here, Flaming Katy, growing in water (after designed), made several my small koi (Wikipedia introduction: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Koi ) and a couple of golden frogs (it's very hard to find their specific type, which we can refer to its frog article and try to find: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frog ) feel very happy in their universe. Sorry, my little ones, I didn't have too much money and time to make you happy, but I can bring many small items bought during the trips to UK and many other places of China, into the fish tank. Meanwhile, we - teachers and learners - have piano music to let you dance... Especially the two frogs , I found: when they heard some plays of beautiful piano-music from students, they really wanted to swimming-dance, as if they were also performers in their small world.

And, I like this picture, in which you can make a sense of Chinese traditional culture, meanwhile, mixed with modern ecological fashion. You knew, the heat, in a whole winter, can make plants and fish tank work above. At the same time, it's a system that materials and energy were exchanged among water, plants, fish and frogs (cleaners). You can feel a simple naturalism of my heart, which I would like to bring into my classroom.

As above, this picture was another angle in the same series...

Artist.value: Jason M. C., Han
